name: Near Net Shape Manufacturing
description: Metal Casting: Introduction and fundamentals of different casting processes and their applications in near net shape manufacturing of complicated shapes such as automotive components. Powder Metallurgy: Powder fabrication routes, compacting, sintering, cold and hot isostatic pressing, field assisted sintering technologies. Powder injection moulding of metals and plastics. Advanced near-net shape manufacturing techniques: Introduction to Additive Manufacturing (AM), Different AM processes, Reverse engineering, post-processing techniques in AM, special properties of AM parts, challenges and advances in additive manufacturing, AI/ML in additive manufacturing.
